# Domestica Hobart Full AI Summary

## Business Overview

Domestica Hobart provides Airbnb management support, Airbnb cleaning, short-stay turnover cleaning, and general cleaning in Hobart, Tasmania, Australia. The business is focused on helping short-stay hosts, homeowners, and apartment owners keep properties clean, stocked, checked, and ready for guests.

## Services

### Airbnb Management Support

Domestica Hobart supports Airbnb and short-stay hosts with turnover coordination, guest-ready presentation, restocking, linen changes, and property checks between bookings.

### Airbnb Cleaning

Domestica Hobart provides Airbnb cleaning and short-stay turnover cleaning in Hobart. Cleaning can include kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, beds, linen changes, bins, floors, restocking, and final presentation details.

### Short-Stay Turnover Cleaning

The service is designed for homes and apartments that need to be reset between guests. Turnover tasks can include cleaning, changing linen, restocking guest amenities, checking the property, and preparing the space for the next arrival.

### General Cleaning

Domestica Hobart also provides general cleaning support for homes, apartments, and short-stay properties in Hobart.
